verdict.rationale: OpenTofu is explicitly positioned as a drop-in replacement for Terraform that preserves existing workflows, configurations, and (per community reports) requires only a simple substitution to migrate, with no rewrite of state or code needed. Community testimonials corroborate real-world migrations of existing Terraform codebases/clients to OpenTofu with minimal friction.  Missing for 10: an explicit first-party state-migration guide or version-compatibility matrix, and independent verification of large/complex state migrations beyond anecdotal HN comments.
